description:
Title: LAN Party

You are planning a LAN party for 10 friends, so the first thing you have to do is to send invitations to these 10 friends.
Next, you have to find out which games they want to play.
As soon as you have received a list of games, you can appoint a date when the LAN party is going to happen.
If 8 or more people agree on this date, you are good to continue.
Else, you have to appoint another date, until 8 people are free to join you.
While you find a date, you can find out if you have all the games your guests want to play.
If some are missing, download them.
Next, you should find out how much beer your friends will require.
If you do not have enough, buy what's missing.
After that, you can enjoy the LAN party.

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Merge_Date" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Gateway_DateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Join">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">at least 8 friends agree on the date</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Split"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="All owned" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Merge_Games">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">all requested games are owned</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Merge_Games"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_EstimateBeer" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Not enough" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">not enough beer is available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="Enough" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Merge_Beer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">enough beer is available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Merge_Beer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Merge_Beer" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="End_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
